Ministers and officials inspect arrangements for the visit of Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu and Deputy Chief Minister K. Pawan Kalyan to Ramapuram in SPSR Nellore district on Monday. | Photo Credit: Chandrababu Naidu

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu and Deputy Chief Minister K. Pawan Kalyan will participate in the Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission-Grameen (VB-G RAM G) ‘Palle Panduga’ programme at Ramapuram village in Udayagiri Assembly constituency in SPSR Nellore district on Thursday (September 24).

Endowments Minister Anam Ramanarayana Reddy, Municipal Administration and Urban Development Minister Ponguru Narayana, Chief Minister’s programme coordinator Mantena Venkata Satyanarayana Raju, Nellore Collector Himanshu Shukla and Superintendent of Police Ajitha Vejendla inspected the arrangements at Ramapuram on Monday.

The Ministers reviewed the arrangements with officials, including those for the helipad, vehicle parking, meeting venue, VIP movement and public facilities. They also enquired about the responsibilities assigned to various departments.

Anticipating a large turnout, the Ministers directed the officials to focus on drinking water, sanitation, traffic management, parking, electricity, medical services and security arrangements. They stressed the need for coordination among all departments and instructed officials to ensure there were no lapses.

Later, they inspected the ongoing works at the gosala (cow shelter) at Kakolluvaripalli, which is scheduled to be inaugurated by Mr. Naidu. They directed the officials concerned to complete the works and ensure that all necessary facilities were in place before the inauguration.
